criteria.summary: N6-01 · OPEN · 초기 finite state 구성
criteria.text:
N6-01 · OPEN · 초기 finite state 구성primary curls 뒤temporal mean update와다섯moment correction을수행하여j=0 상태를만든다. 합격: Proposition9.5
의B0=0.7,C0*=1.2와(9.9),(9.10) 명세를충족한다. 명세의상수없이경험적power slope만으로인증하지않는다.[

]남은 조건: Assemble the required original bands and labels, then apply the actual temporal-mean and five-moment updates. · Recompute full pressure after both updates and establish the exact B0=0.7, C0*=1.2 and (9.9)-(9.10) class constants.원문 MathScope_Research_IDE_Blueprint_v1_KO(1)(20261012-061419).pdf · p.62 · 전체 조건 완료: false

N6-02 · PARTIAL · 전체 residual 재계산R(u+δu,p+δp)=R(u,p)+Lu(δu,δp)+div(δu⊗δu)를사용하며매substep 후최신압력을복원한다. 합격: 독립직접PDE
평가와decomposed residual이오차예산내일치한다. 기존flat tail와새quadratic remainder를장부에서누락하지않
는다.[
  "navier/galerkin.mjs",
  "navier/evidence/acceptance.json",
  "navier/evidence/source-current-20261012/source-current-execution.json",
  "navier/evidence/source-current-20261012/full-pressure.json",
  "navier/evidence/source-current-20261012/current-signed-stress.json",
  "navier/SOURCE_RECONSTRUCTION_KO.md"
]남은 조건: Construct full auxiliary pressure after the actual signed update and after every later correction substep. · Compare independent complete physical PDE evaluation with the full decomposed source residual, including the old flat tail, every quadratic product and explicit error budgets.원문 MathScope_Research_IDE_Blueprint_v1_KO(1)(20261012-061419).pdf · p.62 · 전체 조건 완료: false

criteria.summary: N6-03 · PARTIAL · 비영 angular harmonics 보정
criteria.text:
N6-03 · PARTIAL · 비영 angular harmonics 보정현재source의모든nonzero harmonics를(7.13) inverse로풀고source-supported potentials에cutoff 후curl한다.
합격: same-label 곱에서m+m′ 신규주파수가생성된다. 단계별최대harmonic을기록하고조용한truncation 대신
discarded-mode bound를제공한다.[
  "navier/corrections.mjs",
  "navier/evidence/N6-harmonic.json",
  "navier/evidence/source-current-20261012/source-current-execution.json",

  "navier/source-higher-jets.mjs",
  "navier/SOURCE_RECONSTRUCTION_KO.md"
]남은 조건: Derive the complete same-label current harmonic coefficients from the updated source field. · Solve their actual projected transport equations and realize supported physical curls with commutators and justified mode tails.원문 MathScope_Research_IDE_Blueprint_v1_KO(1)(20261012-061419).pdf · p.62 · 전체 조건 완료: false

N6-04 · PARTIAL · Signed covariance increment고정positive a±에대해δa=(Hcov^−1(Σ/ε))/(2a)를사용한다. 새Σ는signed일수있다. 합격: B(W0,LΣ)=Σ와(7.41)의
세remainder를모두검사한다. 앞단계a±를새residual에맞춰몰래재선택하지않는다.[

criteria.summary: N6-05 · PARTIAL · Zero auxiliary mean Fourier inverse
criteria.text:
N6-05 · PARTIAL · Zero auxiliary mean Fourier inverse(8.19)의1/(2πi vt·k) multiplier로(8.20)을풀고axial increment는(8.14)의potential로실현한다. 합격: zero mode가
0이고Nφ=F가맞는다. |vt·k|^−1≤C(1+|k|) 및4개추가도함수를포함한Fourier tail를기록한다.[
  "navier/corrections.mjs",
  "navier/evidence/N6-workbench.json",

  "navier/evidence/source-current-20261012/higher-pulse-jets.json",
  "navier/SOURCE_RECONSTRUCTION_KO.md"
]남은 조건: Compute the actual zero-mean source coefficients and the original divisor/extra-four-derivative bounds for each required order. · Realize the axial potential and divergence-compatible radial update with A1 and all cutoff remainders retained in the next actual pressure/residual.원문 MathScope_Research_IDE_Blueprint_v1_KO(1)(20261012-061419).pdf · p.62 · 전체 조건 완료: false

criteria.summary: N6-06 · PARTIAL · 다섯 radial equations와 압력
criteria.text:
N6-06 · PARTIAL · 다섯 radial equations와 압력(8.25)로두보존모멘트와P,Jθ,Jz를보정하고(8.12)로pressure를다시계산한다. 합격: 두보존적분은0으로유지되고새
결함은(8.26),(8.27)의nonlinear remainder와일치한다. λ의작은값에따른condition number를통제한다.[
  "navier/source-mean-map.mjs",

  "navier/SOURCE_RECONSTRUCTION_KO.md"
]남은 조건: Apply the authentic fixed mean map to these current defects after the temporal update. · Recompute the complete updated pressure and both conservation integrals, then verify (8.26)-(8.27) with all nonlinear current means and the original lambda-conditioned derivative bounds.원문 MathScope_Research_IDE_Blueprint_v1_KO(1)(20261012-061419).pdf · p.62 · 전체 조건 완료: false

criteria.summary: N6-07 · PARTIAL · 고정 도메인과 차수 향상
criteria.text:
N6-07 · PARTIAL · 고정 도메인과 차수 향상σj=1/5+j/10, gj=hj/10 및(9.17),(9.18)의Km,ℓm,log powers를추적한다. 합격: 모든finite stage가같은q<qbig 도메
인을사용한다. 단한번의step에서샘플잔차가늘면정밀도/범위/상수부터조사하고차수theorem과혼동하지않는다.[
  "navier/corrections.mjs",
  "navier/evidence/N6-workbench.json",
  "navier/evidence/source-current-20261012/source-current-execution.json",
  "navier/evidence/source-current-20261012/higher-pulse-jets.json",
  "navier/evidence/source-current-20261012/current-signed-stress.json",
  "navier/SOURCE_RECONSTRUCTION_KO.md"
]남은 조건: Establish one common original qbig and all required constants for the complete initialized correction stages. · Carry every physical derivative loss and differentiated tail on that fixed domain; do not infer the order theorem from sample residual changes.원문 MathScope_Research_IDE_Blueprint_v1_KO(1)(20261012-061419).pdf · p.62 · 전체 조건 완료: false

N6-08 · OPEN · 최종 local 합성(9.21)에서Aj,Bj,pj에shrinking cutoff를적용하고curl하여local field를만든다. finite residual의flat terms를무조건합
산하지않는다. 합격: Lemma5.4의tail 비교로(9.20)을연결한다. 평가구간의active indices와생략tail의bound를저장
하고없으면finite-stage approximation으로제한한다.[
